description: Check up to 100 domains or IPv4 addresses against a threat IOC feed in one call. $0.5 USDC on Base per call. Resolves each domain and matches names, parent domains and IPv4 against ThreatCluster's high-confidence 30-day IOC feed. Stale feed answers 503 before payment. Don't use this for ransomware claim lookups; use /v1/threat-check. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
